As a Welder, you are responsible for welding aluminum profiles with quality and precision. You make sure every profile is processed according to the agreed guidelines, playing an important role in the production of design lighting fixtures.

A typical day includes operating the welding robot or TIG welding machine, preparing and cutting profiles, and setting the rolling machine. Together with your colleagues, you follow up on the order lists to ensure everything is completed accurately and on time. You work with great attention to detail and strive for a neat end result each time.

Are you passionate about technology and enjoy working with your hands? Do you want to be part of a team where you help create unique products? Apply quickly and discover this opportunity!

• Technical background
• Training in metalwork is a plus
• Experience as a welder (aluminum)
• You work accurately and pay attention to detail
• Good knowledge of Dutch or English

Are you the Incident Manager we’re looking for?

We are looking for an experienced Incident / Problem Manager to join an Application Support team based in Brussels.

You will play a key role in managing application-related incidents and problems, with a strong focus on reducing recurring incidents, improving service stability, and driving continuous improvement.

You will join a small, collaborative team and work closely with technical and application support teams to ensure incidents are effectively managed, root causes are identified, and appropriate corrective actions are implemented.
Role
• Manage the end-to-end Incident Management process for application-related incidents.
• Lead and coordinate the Problem Management process, including root cause analysis and corrective actions.
• Monitor and follow up on application-related incidents, ensuring appropriate prioritisation and resolution.
• Identify trends and recurring incidents and implement actions to reduce incident volumes.
• Support the management of incidents across different priority levels, including P3–P4.
• Monitor application environments using Datadog.
• Work with ServiceNow for incident and problem management.
• Analyse incident trends and identify opportunities for service improvement.
• Collaborate with application, infrastructure, and technical teams to resolve complex issues.
• Contribute to the continuous improvement of application support and IT service management processes.
• Participate in an on-call rotation, currently expected to be approximately one week in three. Out-of-hours incident volumes are currently low.
Profile
We are looking for someone with a backgound Incident Management, Problem Management, or Application Support experience.

You should have:

• Proven experience in Incident Management and/or Problem Management or Support engineering. .
• Previous experience within an Application Support environment.
• Experience working with ServiceNow.
• Experience with Datadog or a similar monitoring solution.
• Good working knowledge of SQL.
• A hands-on approach and the ability to work closely with technical teams.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Good communication and stakeholder-management skills.
• The ability to work effectively in a small, collaborative team.
• Fluent/professional English.

You will be modelling a highly diverse set of treatment processes and plants for water industry
 

clients worldwide, with the goal of reducing greenhouse gas emissions, improving waterquality,
 

saving resources and making plants smart. By mastering and applying modelling techniques such
 

as bio/chemical kinetics, computational fluid dynamics (CFD) or the combination, you will unravel
 

what is happening inside water treatment systems and will be able to improve processes
 

significantly. After a while, you will be able to execute rather spectacular modelling work, for which
 

AM-Team is known. The complexity of the modelling projects will grow along with and will be
 

adjusted to your modelling knowledge and experience. You will also be developing a broad
 

knowledge on existing and novel industry processes.
 

The objectives of your modelling projects will be highly case dependent, but mostly you will make
 

clients happy by saving costs, saving energy, improving technology and competitive position,
 

accelerating technology development, and improving process performance and reliability.
 

Main responsibilities
 

• 
Project execution & delivery: Executing multiple modelling projects & delivery of the
 

project outcomes to the customers in the shape of reports and presentations. Typically,
 

projects execution involves. 2/3
 

Job offering – Solution Engineer
 

o Understanding project objectives & gathering relevant data
 

o Planning project milestones and executing projects in a stepwise & collaborative
 

manner.
 

o Organizing client meetings and preparing presentations & reports.
 

o Supporting other team members with expert knowledge.
 

• 
Technical communication & dissemination: Internal & external communication on
 

projects and at international events or in online webinars. Writing technical abstracts,
 

journal articles and social media technical blogs or posts.
 

• 
Research & development: Developing new modelling solutions tailored to market needs
 

in close collaboration with the team. Creating templates and SOPs for existing modelling
 

methods.
 

• 
Coaching & training: Continuous learning & improving through active trainings. Also
 

coaching others.
 

You will be guided by senior colleagues at the start and will gradually grow and do your work more
 

autonomously.

• Has at least 2-3 years of water or wastewater industry or relevant academic experience
 

related to working with modelling projects.
 

• Has at least MSc in (environmental/bioscience or relevant) engineering. Has strong
 

understanding and educational background of water treatment processes and/or
 

modelling of these processes. Knowledge and experience with CFD modelling is a plus.
 

• Deeply shares AM-Team’s core values.
 

o We value the fun factor: working with us makes you smile and makes us smile.
 

o Why should the sky be the limit? You are a person that is not afraid to think out of
 

the box and set ambitious goals.
 

o A team is so much more than a bunch of individuals: you are a true team player.
 

o We tailor to enhance value but fit for purpose: we stand for quality and the tailoring
 

of our approach to our team and customers.
 

o We have no boundary conditions: we have no geographical, cultural, or technical
 

boundaries.
 

o We never settle, and keep stirring, we want to infinitely learn and improve, both as
 

team and individuals
 

• Is interested in the wonder world of digitalisation and has passion for innovation.
 

• Is eager to learn and curious.
 

• Has ability to ask the right questions and carefully listen to clients to help them maximally
 

and truly understand their needs and problems.
 

• Has good (self) organisational skills and takes initiative.
 

• Has good presentation skills and can explain things simply, even when they are complex.
 

• Is fluent in English both written and orally - knowledge of another language is a plus (e.g.
 

Dutch, French, or German).

A technical role that makes models and digital twins deliver lasting value at the global scale
 

We’re looking for a water-passioned person that loves combining the water and wastewater
 

treatment side with data, models and digital twins. This role focuses on translating models and
 

data into real value for end customers at the global scale. Beyond the buzz. You will be working
 

in our technical team and will also be interacting regularly with our sales team.

• Has at least 3 years of water or wastewater industry or relevant academic experience related
 

to working with data, mechanistic modelling or hybrid modelling projects.
 

• Has an MSc in (environmental/bioscience or relevant) engineering. Has strong understanding of water treatment processes and associated modelling / data handling of those.
 

• Preferably has specific expertise in data science applications for (waste)water treatment
 

• Is willing to be working from our office in Ghent, Belgium
 

• Has good communication skills and can explain complex matter to customers
 

• Is fluent in English, both written and orally - knowledge of another language is a plus
 

• Shares our company values
 
 

• Transformative digital thought leadership: With the work we do, we don’t just create impact and improve things. We transform the water industry by providing cutting-edge digital solutions. 

• Innovation that solves: We dare to push boundaries and see innovation as a necessity in today’s world. However, dreaming is not enough. Practicality matters as well. Innovative thinking + practicality = impact 

• Together we are one team and pursue shared ambitions: A team is much more than a bunch of individuals. We believe we need people that are different in skills and similar in values to achieve big things

Step into a rewarding role as a Lift Technician where your technical prowess will keep crucial lift systems running smoothly. You’ll be part of a dedicated team responsible for installation, maintenance, and repair services, ensuring safety and reliability. Your daily tasks will include troubleshooting, performing mechanical and electrical maintenance, and collaborating closely with clients and team members to deliver top-notch service. 

An average day will see you working independently on various customer sites, primarily within the province of Antwerp. You'll tackle a range of mechanical and electrical challenges, ensuring each lift is operating safely and efficiently. Your problem-solving skills will be put to good use as you diagnose issues and implement effective solutions.

If you’re ready to elevate your career in a role that offers both challenge and opportunity, apply today! Your journey towards becoming a key player in our technical team starts here.

• Technical school diploma or equivalent experience
• Background in mechanical and/or electrical fields
• Valid Category B driving license
• Strong problem-solving skills
• Ability to work independently and manage your schedule
• Good communication skills in English
• Flexible and responsible attitude

We are looking for an enthusiastic sorting assistant for a company in Zulte that specializes in sorting and distributing clothing!

We are looking for a motivated sorting assistant to join our team.

In this position, you will be responsible for sorting various materials and processing them correctly.

What will you be doing?

• Sorting second-hand clothing into different qualities.
• Working at a good pace – you are dynamic and accurate.
• No allergies to dust and no physical complaints.
• You preferably live nearby or you have a car

What are our expectations?

• Knowledge of Dutch or English is required.
• Willingness to perform physical work.
• You are not allergic to dust!
• You are not colourblind!
• Accuracy and attention to detail.
• You are looking for a long-term job.
• You live close to Zulte or you have a car
• You are motivated and enjoy working in a team.

Are you ready to take your career in offset printing to the next level? We are seeking a skilled Offset Printer to ensure our high-quality standards are met in every print run. This is a fantastic opportunity to join a team that values precision, efficiency, and teamwork.

In this role, your day will start by setting up and operating our state-of-the-art offset printing machines. You will be responsible for maintaining the printers, ensuring consistent quality, and troubleshooting any issues that arise during the production process. Collaboration is key as you'll work alongside other professionals to meet production goals and deadlines.

If you're passionate about printing and looking for a role where your contributions are valued, apply now! Join us and become an integral part of a workplace that offers growth and learning opportunities.

• At least 2-3 years of experience as an offset printer
• Technical qualifications in printing at A2/A3 level or equivalent experience
• Experience in multi-color offset printing; experience in printing on solid board or CBA is an additional advantage
• Team player with strong communication skills and the ability to maintain a collaborative work environment
• Attention to detail with an excellent sense of quality and safety
• Communicative knowledge of English or Dutch

As a Recruitment Consultant, you will operate as a true 360° consultant, managing both client relationships and candidate processes. This role combines recruitment expertise with a strong commercial focus and offers the opportunity to develop your own market and portfol

Client Details

Michael Page is a globally recognised recruitment consultancy specialising in the placement of qualified professionals and managers across a wide range of sectors, including Finance, Human Resources, Sales & Marketing, Engineering, Supply Chain, Digital & Technology, Legal, and more.

As part of our continued growth in Belgium, we are looking for ambitious and driven individuals to join our Brussels office and contribute to our success while building their own professional career.

Description
Business Development & Sales
• Identify and prospect new business opportunities within your market.
• Develop and manage a portfolio of clients across different industries.
• Conduct client meetings to understand hiring needs and business challenges.
• Negotiate commercial agreements and recruitment partnerships.
• Build long-term relationships with key decision-makers and HR stakeholders.
• Become a trusted advisor for your clients regarding talent acquisition and market trends.Recruitment & Talent Acquisition
• Manage the full recruitment lifecycle from briefing to placement.
• Source and engage top talent through LinkedIn, job boards, networking, and referrals.
• Conduct interviews and assess candidates' skills, experience, and motivations.
• Present qualified candidates to clients and manage the interview process.
• Deliver an exceptional candidate experience throughout the recruitment journey.
• Build and maintain a strong talent pipeline within your specialisation.Client Relationship Management
• Act as the main point of contact for your clients.
• Provide market insights and salary benchmarking.
• Ensure a high level of service and client satisfaction.
• Develop long-term partnerships based on trust and expertise.
 

• Previous experience in sales, business development, recruitment, consulting, customer service, or a commercial role.
• Strong interest in business development and client relationship management.
• Entrepreneurial mindset and passion for achieving results.
• Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
• Resilient, ambitious, and motivated by targets and performance.
• Ability to work in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.
• Fluent in French and English or Dutch and English.
• Fluency in French, Dutch, and English is considered a significant advantage.

Key Responsibilities

• 
Diagnose and troubleshoot mechanical, electrical, and electronic issues in trucks

• 
Perform maintenance and repairs, including oil and filter changes, brake installation and bleeding, and component replacements

• 
Handle each assigned vehicle from A to Z, ensuring all required tasks are completed efficiently and accurately

• 
Document all work performed in line with company procedures

• 
Follow established time standards, safety guidelines, and quality requirements

• 
Cooperate with the workshop team and report to the workshop supervisor

• 
Education: Technical qualification or vocational training in truck mechanics or equivalent

• 
Experience: Minimum 3 years of relevant experience as a truck technician or diagnostic mechanic

• 
Driving licence: Category B required (C is an advantage)

• 
Languages: Basic communication skills in English or French

• 
Availability: Occasional on-call duty (once per month); no standard weekend work

Key Competencies

• 
Strong problem-solving ability and technical insight

• 
Team player with a proactive and reliable work attitude

• 
Adheres to safety standards and consistently uses PPE

• 
Open communicator, direct and honest in feedback

• 
Motivated to develop and grow within a professional workshop environment

For this fast-growing Belgian company with various subsidiaries in Europe, we are currently looking for an accountant to join an experienced finance department.
 

In this role, you are in charge of a portfolio of projects at various stages of development. You will be responsible for all accounting, tax (in cooperation with an external accounting & tax consultancy) and administrative requirements.
 

The job is based in Olen.
 

 
 

Accountant – The Role:
 

- 
 Review the booking of various invoices (AP/AR/bank statements)
 

- 
 Prepare the month- and year-end closings, as well as the annual accounts
 

- 
 Prepare the monthly VAT return, as well at the corporate tax return
 

- 
 Regular reporting to the company’s Finance Manager
 

 

Accountant – About You:
 

- 
 You have obtained a Bachelor’s degree in Accounting
 

- 
 You have at least 2 years of experience in a similar role
 

- 
 You are fluent in Dutch & English

For our client specialized in steel, we are looking for a motivated Machine Operator!

Job Description:

• 
Set up machines according to the given instructions. 

• 
Monitor the entire process until the finished product. 

• 
Perform physical work where necessary. 

Who are you?

• 
You speak Dutch or English

You have experience as an operator in the metal industry

• 
A stable CV with relevant experiences.

Are you passionate about industrial technology and do you gain energy from solving technical challenges?

For our sites in Neder-over-Heembeek and Brucargo, we are looking for a Maintenance Technician who maintains and optimises industrial installations with dedication and expertise.

You will play a key role in ensuring the reliability of our technical systems. We invest in safety, training and your development, and we value your technical expertise. Together, we build a future based on innovation, reliability and teamwork.

Your responsibilities

 
• Preventive maintenance: carry out preventive maintenance according to the maintenance plan and inspect machines to avoid breakdowns.
 
• Corrective & improvement maintenance: analyse and resolve faults, replace or adjust parts, consult technical documentation and ensure optimal machine performance.
 
• Optimisation: analyse recurring issues and propose improvement actions to increase performance and availability.
 
• Use of CMMS: record interventions, write fault analyses, prepare reports and monitor stock levels.
 
• Safety: ensure a clean and safe working environment and actively contribute to safety improvements.
 
• Support & training: provide technical support to colleagues and operational teams.
 
• Quality & environment: work in accordance with current procedures (ISO 9001 & ISO 14001).

 
• Solid technical background (mechanics, electricity or electromechanics). 
 
• Autonomous, thorough and solution‑oriented. 
 
• Experience with industrial installations is an asset. Knowledge of CMMS systems is a plus. 
 
• Strong safety awareness, quality‑oriented and eager to learn. 
 
• Willing to work in a 3‑shift system (Mon–Fri). 
 
• Excellent command of English; knowledge of French / Dutch is an advantage

As a Accountant, you will monitor, analyse, and report key expense categories while ensuring accurate financial reporting and effective cost control. Acting as a business partner to various departments, you will provide valuable insights that support operational efficiency and strategic decision-making.

Bedrijfsomschrijving

This position is within the property industry and based near Ternat.

Omschrijving

Reporting to the Accounting Manager, your responsibilities will include:

• Monitoring and analysing operational expenses and project-related costs.
• Managing and overseeing the invoice and purchase order cycle.
• Reviewing accounting entries, allocations, and VAT-related controls.
• Supporting month-end and year-end closing activities, including accruals, reconciliations, and intercompany transactions.
• Performing variance analysis and preparing financial reporting for key stakeholders.
• Supporting budgeting, forecasting, and audit processes.
• Ensuring compliance with accounting standards and internal control procedures.
• Contributing to process improvements, financial systems enhancements, and European-wide projects.
• Collaborating with internal stakeholders to drive transparency, efficiency, and cost optimisation.
• Supporting knowledge-sharing and collaboration within the finance team.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics, or equivalent experience.
• Minimum 4-5 years of experience in accounting or financial reporting.
• Previous experience within a services, retail, or similar operational environment.
• Strong understanding of accounting principles and financial controls.
• Experience with SAP; S4Hana knowledge is considered a strong asset.
• Advanced Excel skills.
• Good knowledge of IFRS and/or local GAAP standards is an advantage.
• Fluent English communication skills; additional European languages are a plus.
• Analytical, proactive, and solution-oriented mindset.
• Comfortable working in an international and fast-paced environment

For a company in the meat industry Oudenaarde, we are looking for an All-round Technician.

What will your responsibilities be?

• You will be responsible for corrective, preventive and improvement-oriented maintenance of the machinery, equipment and buildings. 
• You will carry out scheduled maintenance and perform the necessary repairs. 
• You will ensure the production machinery operates optimal.

Who are you?

• You are able to identify and resolve technical faults. 
• You have a good command of either Dutch or English.

Bedrijfsomschrijving 
Do you enjoy technical, hands-on work and want to see the tangible results of what you do? As an on-site installer, you will help install and finish plastic installations directly at customer locations, mainly in the agricultural sector.

You will work on a day schedule, on different projects and at various locations, with a salary between €17 and €19 per hour, plus additional benefits.

 
• 
Install plastic walls, pipes and connection components.

 
• 
Carry out hot-air welding work.

 
• 
Install fastening elements and ensure the work is finished neatly.

 
• 
Assist with basement fitting and the installation of wall and facade cladding.

 
• 
Help position installations using a crane.

 
• 
Perform simple electrical work, such as pulling cables.

 
• 
You enjoy working outdoors and at different locations.

 
•

• 
You enjoy learning new things.

 
• 
Experience in the field is an advantage, but not required.

 
• 
You do not need prior knowledge of plastic welding, as this is taught within the company.

 
• 
You speak English.

Step into a role that molds the very foundation of tomorrow's structures. As a Concrete Worker, you play a crucial role in preparing, placing, and finishing concrete for various structural projects. Work with a dedicated team to bring blueprints to life, ensuring that every measure is executed to perfection.

Picture your day starting with a collaborative briefing with your team, followed by hands-on work where you prepare formwork, place and finish concrete, and ensure every detail aligns with design specifications. You will be reading construction plans, placing reinforcements, and ensuring site cleanliness, all while maintaining a safe and productive work environment.

Are you ready to take your construction career to the next level? If you are motivated, physically fit, and willing to learn, we want you! Apply now and become a part of a team that values skill and dedication.

• At least 1 year of experience in construction

• Ability to read construction drawings

• Communicative English

• Physically fit and hardworking

• Motivated to learn and grow

• Flexible and hands-on attitude

• Own transportation is a plus

• VCA certificate or willingness to obtain one

This large Belgian company plays a key role and manages an extensive and technically complex network. Behind the scenes, high-performing and reliable IT systems ensure that operational processes run safely and efficiently. Within this business-critical environment, significant investments are being made in modern software development and sustainable IT architecture.You will join an experienced team operating in an Enterprise environment where quality, collaboration, and long-term vision are central.
Jobomschrijving
You will contribute to the development and optimization of applications that support operations with real-time data & feedback. You will implement new features and improve existing modules within a modern frontend stack where performance, reliability, and usability are key.You will also support the team with your technical expertise in Angular, helping maintain high standards in code quality, maintainability, and reusability. You will collaborate closely with backend engineers, UX specialists, and product stakeholders in an Agile/Scrum environment to deliver robust and scalable enterprise applications.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in IT (or equivalent through strong experience)
• Senior professional experience with Angular & front-end development in general
• Experience in Java-environments
•  10 years of experience in IT
• You're a pragmatic team player
• You work in English and understand Dutch & French

As Lead Full Stack Developer, you take a key role in the further development and evolution of a suite of business-critical applications used in real-time operational environments.You remain strongly hands-on in both backend and frontend development, working primarily with .NET and Angular, while also guiding technical choices, improving existing implementations and helping shape upcoming solutions. You challenge current approaches where needed and translate complex technical topics into clear and pragmatic proposals.A major part of the role is technical leadership. You support and coach other developers, promote knowledge sharing and help maintain high standards in code quality, maintainability and software design. You work closely with analysts, architects, testers and other developers within an Agile/Scrum setup.You also keep a close eye on delivery, scope and technical risks. When dependencies, architectural concerns or implementation issues arise, you identify them early and help the team move towards a robust and sustainable solution.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in IT (or equivalent through strong experience)
• Senior professional experience in .NET & Angular
• +15 years of experience in IT
• You're a pragmatic team player
• You work in English and understand Dutch & French

Are you ready to take your career to the next level as a CNC Turner/Programmer? This role places you at the heart of precision manufacturing, where you'll operate and program CNC turning machines using advanced Heidenhain and Siemens control systems. Your expertise will ensure the production of high-quality, custom-made spare parts for various industrial applications.

A typical day involves collaborating with a team of five skilled professionals, programming and operating CNC machines, and ensuring finished products meet rigorous quality standards. You'll also engage in measuring and inspecting workpieces and occasionally assist in hydraulic cylinder repairs. A clean, organized workspace is a must to maintain safety and efficiency.

If you're passionate about precision and innovation, apply today to join a team that values expertise and teamwork!

• Proven experience as a CNC Turner/Programmer

• Proficiency in Heidenhain and Siemens control systems

• Strong attention to detail

• Ability to work both independently and as part of a team

• Experience in custom machining and measuring techniques

• Good level of English

• Willingness to work in a day shift, starting at 07:00 or 08:00

Do you have a solid experience as a CE Truck Driver and enjoy delivering items from point A to point B? Then this might be exactly the opportunity you're looking for! We're looking for a reliable professional who takes pride in delivering vehicles in perfect condition.
In this role, you will take charge of transporting various vehicles, including vans and trucks, to different destinations.

Checking the load, transport documentation, and ensuring everything is delivered correctly.

• Experience with vehicle loading, securing, and transport. 
 
•  
A precise, safety-focused way of working. 

 
•  
Proficiency in Dutch or English (French is a plus) 

 
•  
A friendly, professional communication style and appearance.

Flexibility: your schedule won't always be a standard 9-to-5; starting earlier or finishing later is part of the job.
